name: ind-core
description: XELOR Manufacturing Intelligence — boundary-enforced modular monolith (MVP prototype 1). Baseline: DECISIONS-V2 (binding).

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ind-core/platform build && pnpm --filter @ind-core/db build && pnpm --filter @ind-core/api start:dev
scripts.ai:eval: pnpm --filter @ind-core/api eval general.master_dedup && pnpm --filter @ind-core/api eval csp.ticket_triage && pnpm --filter @ind-core/api eval expenditure.receipt_extraction && pnpm --filter @ind-core/api eval admin.sod_explain && pnpm --filter @ind-core/api ai:grounding
scripts.ci: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm test && pnpm ai:eval && pnpm db:rls-check && pnpm db:perm-check && pnpm db:naming-check && pnpm module-check && pnpm report-data-check
scripts.demo:rebuild: pnpm db:demo-reset --yes && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm demo:seed && pnpm demo:northstar
